critical.issue: delete_thread function in /app/backend/routers/forum.py line 90 is MISSING its @router.delete decorator. The function follows immediately after create_thread's `return doc` without a route decorator, so it is unreachable. Owners cannot delete their own forum threads via API. Admin delete works via /api/admin/forum-threads/{id} only.

minor.issue: Auto-overwrites last_updated to now() if admin omits the field — admin must always pass last_updated in PUT body to preserve a previously-set date. Slightly counterintuitive.

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: Add `@router.delete("/threads/{thread_id}")` decorator above the `async def delete_thread(...)` line in /app/backend/routers/forum.py (currently around line 90, between create_thread's `return doc` and the bare `async def delete_thread` declaration). Without it, owner-side thread deletion via the public API is broken.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG: /app/backend/routers/forum.py — `delete_thread` function defined without @router.delete decorator, making the endpoint unreachable. This was likely a copy-paste regression when adding tags/vehicle_label fields.
PUT /api/legal/{slug} silently overwrites last_updated to current timestamp when admin doesn't pass it. Worth documenting or making it explicit (require admin to pass last_updated to change it).
_failed_attempts/_lockouts in admin.py are in-memory dicts — reset on backend restart (already flagged in iter1, still applies).
Marketplace listings POST happily accepts make/model with no validation (free-form strings). Could allow inconsistent casing affecting filter UX. Consider canonicalizing on insert.
Forum thread creation caps tags at 5 client+server side (good); however no de-duplication or trim of whitespace on tag entries — duplicates with trailing spaces would slip through.

rca of the issue: DELETE /api/forum/threads/{id} bug RCA: When iter3 added the ThreadIn fields (vehicle_label + tags) and the auto-derive vehicle_label logic in create_thread, the @router.delete decorator that previously sat above `async def delete_thread` got removed/lost. Reproduction: send DELETE /api/forum/threads/{any_id} with valid user token → returns 405 Method Not Allowed (because the FastAPI route doesn't exist). Mitigation: insert `@router.delete("/threads/{thread_id}")` on a new line just above `async def delete_thread(thread_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user)):` in routers/forum.py.
